question: Round start Split, 5v5 full-buy, no one dead. You are Raze at Mid Top with your team spread out. How do you open the round to maximize offensive options?

options.label: Contest Mid first (Vents + Mid Bot) with util to open the A Sewer and B Back splits, creating a two-site dilemma
options.explication_courte: On Split, Mid control is the round pivot: it opens A Sewer and B Back and turns a one-dimensional push into a split the DEF cannot answer with standard rotations.

options.label: Execute directly onto A Main grouped with smokes and flashes, skip Mid entirely
options.explication_courte: A grouped default hit on A Main is playable, but without Mid control you attack a one-dimensional choke that DEF have set up for.

sources_option.citation: Split rewards owning a vertical/mid position; hitting a site straight through a chokepoint without mid control lets defenders rotate and flank through mid freely.

options.label: Post one OP in Vents and another at Heaven-side to lock two vertical Mid angles passively
options.explication_courte: Double-OP passive on two vertical angles immobilizes two players without taking any space; on Split, controlling Mid actively is far more valuable than locking angles.

sources_option.citation: Putting an OPer in Vents and another in Heaven is tempting but not advised; prioritize double-stacking one side for a potential split rather than sitting two passive verticals.

options.label: Rush A Ramp solo early to fish for a pick before your team is in position
options.explication_courte: A solo A Ramp rush before the team is set gets punished: you hand the enemy a free pick, break team tempo, and alert DEF to the A side early.

sources_option.citation: The battle for Mid is the fulcrum of a Split round; an uncoordinated solo push into a site chokepoint donates a free duel and gathers no usable space.

explication_longue:
Situation: round start Split, 5v5 full-buy both sides, you are Raze at Mid Top with your team spread. The question is how to open the round for maximum offensive options.

Split is the map where Mid control decides round structure. Holding Mid means: (1) A Sewer opens a split onto A Site from below, (2) B Back opens a split onto B Site. Without Mid, every execute is one-dimensional and DEF can set up chokepoint holds. The Radiant opening is to use util (Boom Bot, smokes, flashes) to contest Vents and Mid Bot early, then call the resulting split based on DEF reaction.

A grouped A Main execute (acceptable) is viable if Mid is not contested, but you attack into a choke DEF have prepared. Double-OP passive on vertical angles (costly) immobilizes two players without taking space - passive holding loses to DEF who set up freely. Solo A Ramp rush (mistake) breaks team tempo and hands a free pick before execution even starts.

Estimated elite distribution: ~55% Mid contest first then split, ~22% grouped A Main execute, ~16% double-OP passive (costly), ~5% solo A Ramp rush (mistake).

sources.citation: Controlling the central Mid area is paramount on Split and is the strategic fulcrum upon which rounds pivot, granting advantages in rotations, pressure and info.
For attackers, controlling mid opens A Sewer splits toward A Site and B Back splits toward B Site, turning one-dimensional chokepoint pushes into multi-angle executes.
A strong Split attack takes some mid space, identifies where the sentinel and controller utility are stacked, then hits the weaker side with a split or late regroup.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides Split (thunderpick, boosting-ground, upforge, switchblade) ; la frequence mid-first vs A-direct depend de la compo et du plan d'equipe, sans dataset public.
Le hit A Main direct (acceptable) peut etre optimal dans une compo default-heavy avec fort controle util ; la frontiere depend du plan d'equipe non fixe ici.
Positions x/y approximatives sur Mid Split (viewBox 1000x1000, zones de maps.ts) ; l'etat exact de la util Raze restante est une hypothese full-kit.
